lines.trans: In my view, its surface form already illustrates that dialectical principle.
Look: if you read those three characters backwards, the meaning stays exactly the same.
The pattern of all things never freezes in place.
Heaven's way moves in cycles, and yin and yang turn into their opposites.
Close allies can become foes, and enemies can be turned into friends.
Black and white, across games of shifting shades of grey, can sometimes reverse completely.
And so, whether an endeavour succeeds or fails—
sometimes depends on the angle from which you choose to think.
Across Laozi's five thousand words, the core spirit lies in dialectics.
